title: Had given up on my game project. New models really brought it to higher tier of slopfest. How does this look?
author: Secret_Slide_1357

comments.author: alcanthro
comments.body: Looking good.  What engine is it using?

replies.author: Secret_Slide_1357
replies.body:
I didn't use an engine. It's mostly JS and pixi 2d graphics framework.   
I regretted it at the time but now it's just peachy.

replies.author: alcanthro
replies.body: Okay so PixiJS is the engine used.

replies.author: Secret_Slide_1357
replies.body: I guess yeah but not like Godot or Unity.

comments.author: sharkymcstevenson2
comments.body: dude its pretty sick, nice work

comments.author: sw3d
comments.body: Looks nice, I like the roll and crouch/prone, a lot more dynamic than most 2D platforms. Action looks pretty fun

replies.author: Secret_Slide_1357
replies.body: Thanks man. Yeah the autoaim reduces skill level which makes it more fast paced / quick action.

replies.author: sw3d
replies.body: If you get a demo up feel free to post it on r/playtestyourgames for a playtest/review
